CALLER STATES IT ONLY LOOKS LIKE ONE BUCKET SPILLED. THE TRUCK LOAD IS STILL MEANT TO BE DELIVERED TO DALLAS, TX. A TEAM WITH THE REPORTING PARTY'S (RP) COMPANY IS RESPONDING TO HANDLE THE CLEANUP INSIDE THE TRAILER.
